title: Shard KPIs
description: Query strings below are plain-English-adjacent pseudo-SQL, not copy-paste-ready syntax for any specific Grafana datasource plugin — no real backend/datasource is wired up in this build. Source: the OTel metrics payload/tools/metrics_to_otlp.py exports (this phase's Task 1), read-only aggregates over kind:"task"/kind:"learn" records in ~/.claude/metrics/*.jsonl. Exact instrument names as currently implemented in metrics_to_otlp.py's emit_metrics(): claude_agent_loop.tests (Counter, attribute result=passed|failed), claude_agent_loop.error_rate (Histogram, no attributes), claude_agent_loop.verdict (Counter, attribute verdict), claude_agent_loop.resources_source (Counter, attribute resources_source=workorder|task|session-backfill — this aggregate is built only over kind:"task" records, so the sibling value "session" set on kind:"session" records never reaches it), claude_agent_loop.heuristic_firings (Counter, attribute rule=<literal rule id string>). All five are CUMULATIVE-temporality by design (see metrics_to_otlp.py's module docstring) — each export reports the complete running total, never a per-run delta. Every panel query below therefore uses last(value), never sum(value): summing a CUMULATIVE series across N exports would overcount the true value by roughly N. The only exception is the precise-vs-backfill ratio panel, which sums two attribute values WITHIN the same export snapshot and divides one by the other — a ratio of same-snapshot sums is self-normalizing regardless of aggregation function, so it needs no change. A CUMULATIVE-but-can-decrease series is expected here, not a bug: because build_aggregates() re-aggregates the FULL current shard snapshot on every export (never a per-run delta), a value can legitimately drop between exports when a superseded record's contribution changes — for example, a task's verdict flipping from clean to dirty decreases the old "clean" count even though nothing was deleted. This dashboard intentionally carries 6 panels, more than the plan's general "1-3 panels per dashboard" guideline, because each one maps to one of metrics_to_otlp.py's 5 real exported metrics plus the explicitly-requested precise-vs-backfill attribution-ratio panel.

panels.title: Tests passed vs failed
panels.description: Source: claude_agent_loop.tests counter, attribute result. Summed over kind:"task" records' tests sub-object.

targets.query: SELECT result, last(value) FROM claude_agent_loop_tests GROUP BY result

panels.title: error_rate distribution
panels.description: Source: claude_agent_loop.error_rate histogram. Raw error_rate values across kind:"task" records that carry a numeric error_rate (a missing, null, or non-numeric value is excluded, not coerced to zero).

panels.title: Verdict mix
panels.description: Source: claude_agent_loop.verdict counter, attribute verdict. A missing or explicit-null verdict is bucketed as <missing>, never coerced to the string "unknown" — verdict is not a universal kind:"task" field.

targets.query: SELECT verdict, last(value) FROM claude_agent_loop_verdict GROUP BY verdict

panels.title: resources_source mix
panels.description: Source: claude_agent_loop.resources_source counter, attribute resources_source. Only three values are reachable on this metric — workorder/task/session-backfill — since the aggregate is built solely over kind:"task" records; the sibling value "session" is set only on kind:"session" records (harvest_metrics.py's build_record()) and never appears here.

targets.query: SELECT resources_source, last(value) FROM claude_agent_loop_resources_source GROUP BY resources_source

panels.title: Precise-vs-backfill attribution ratio
panels.description: Derived from the same claude_agent_loop.resources_source counter, split per heuristics_eval.py's PRECISE_SOURCES convention: "task"/"workorder" attributions are PRECISE (a specific task, or plan_task.py at assignment time, announced its own resources); "session-backfill" alone is COARSE (inherited from the session's ANNOUNCE, not per-task — heuristics_eval.py's _coarse_count() checks resources_source == "session-backfill" strictly, it never folds in plain "session"). Ratio = precise / (precise + coarse). Broken out as its own explicit panel per the source spec's callout, since session-backfill is the normal ~98% case in real historical data (subagents rarely announce) and a reader should never mistake a coarse-dominated total for a precise one.

targets.query: SELECT sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resources_source IN ('task','workorder')) * 1.0 / sum(value) AS precise_ratio FROM claude_agent_loop_resources_source

panels.title: Heuristic firings by rule
panels.description: Source: claude_agent_loop.heuristic_firings counter, attribute rule — the literal rule-id string from kind:"learn" records (no hardcoded H1-H8 allowlist; a retired or renumbered id such as H0, confirmed present in real historical data, is still counted rather than dropped).

targets.query: SELECT rule, last(value) FROM claude_agent_loop_heuristic_firings GROUP BY rule ORDER BY last(value) DESC
